context:
Goal: keep the global CLAUDE.md small, with each rule loading where it must act.
Problem (rule): the audit moves three Verification rules out of the global CLAUDE.md, and nothing moves without your sign-off.
Based on (ruling): your 12:38 and 12:40 CST Nov 11 words on moving sections, "it would need my sign off".
Based on (measured): the plan's word counts, and its load test: a rule that stops an act must load before that act.
Departs from: main — the screen verdict (25 words) moves to skill design-review (screen reviews), trust-a-guard (13) to .claude/rules/hooks.md, and the checked reader for numbers (14) to skill fresh-prose (rules for docs and records).
Meanwhile: nothing moves before your answer; the guard test file split this waited on is done (merged 07:16 CST Nov 12).
Re-checked 11:39 CST Nov 12: the quoted text is unchanged. Corrections: the target rule file for hooks loads only for files under hooks/, while the planned rule file for guard building loads for hooks/ and lint/, so the two plans disagree on where guard rules load; and "no check confirms these" is overstated: the rule-to-check table (lint/rule_mechanisms.json) has rows for all three. The real cost is that the rule audit reads rule marks only from CLAUDE.md and the reply style.

options.gain: About 52 words leave the global file.
options.how: The lane moves the text as the plan proposes.
options.label: Accept the moves
options.lose: No automatic check confirms these three rules still exist until a later step adds one.

options.gain: The rule loads in every session, before any act.
options.label: Keep it global
options.lose: No words leave the global file.

reply: Recorded 12:00 CST: the moves are accepted. Sent to lane global-claude-md-scope-audit.
title: Where three Verification rules of CLAUDE.md live
why: The lane's pick: each rule acts only where its new home already loads.
